summary: Postinstall script in lookalike-named package warrants manual review
details: The package declares a postinstall hook ("postinstall": "node install.js" in package.json) that executes install.js automatically on npm install. The package name (@solana-labs/ancor) is highly suggestive of impersonation of the official Solana Labs scope and the Anchor framework (anchor → ancor is a one-character edit). The install.js contents were not traced in this analysis, so the actual behavior of the postinstall script is unverified. Given the combination of a lifecycle hook that runs on default install and a name that closely resembles a widely used ecosystem (Solana / Anchor), a human reviewer should inspect install.js before the package is allowed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
